newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso snaps five-day losing streak.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso snaps five-day losing streak.

text.p: Colombia's peso snapped a five-day losing streak and ended 9.8 higher against the dollar at 1,060 after getting a boost from foreign currency sales by exporters and month-end position squaring by banks, traders said.
They said the session was quiet since most banks closed their treasury departments early for month-end accounting purposes.

Dealers reported 268 trades for a total of $128 million and said the peso held in a 1,067.50 to 1,058.10 range. Most interbank traders said they expected to see the peso resume its downward trend next week, but solid support for the currency was seen at 1,080.
